title: GenOffice puts document, spreadsheet, presentation, and PDF editors into one desktop suite
description:
GenOffice puts document, spreadsheet, presentation, and PDF editors into one desktop suite, with model-driven editing built into each workspace. Its most interesting detail is file preservation: DOCX saves regenerate only changed paragraphs, while untouched XML and archive entries remain byte-for-byte intact. Sheets uses a Rust import and export sidecar, and Slides has its own PPTX renderer.  #github #opensource 

https://github.com/genspark-ai/genoffice
